articleTitle: Moving Object Detection Based on Improved Three Frame Difference and Background Subtraction
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of the moving object detection algorithm, a combination of improved three frame difference and background subtraction based on Gaussian mixture model algorithm is proposed in this paper. On the basis of the traditional three frame difference method, the "XOR" and "OR" operations are used instead of the "AND" operation to extract the foreground to solve the hole problem in the extraction of the foreground. But it will cause problems such as elongated target, blurred outline and noise. The background subtraction of Gaussian mixture model extracts the whole foreground but will detect the shadow. We consider combining two foregrounds by using the "AND" operation to obtain a comprehensive foreground image. The experimental results show that the algorithm can extract moving objects quickly, accurately and completely.

articleTitle: Design of Obstacle Avoidance System for Micro-UAV Based on Binocular Vision
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: A hardware system based on binocular vision sensor was designed for the detection and obstacle avoidance of micro-UAV in indoor environment. Using the two consumer-level cameras installed on the UAV from the different locations to obtain image information, by the FPGA combined with binocular vision algorithm to deal with two images after the realization of the three-dimensional depth of the space environment perception, access to the current indoor environment, effectively get the current three-dimensional environmental information. The micro-UAV has the ability to detect and escape obstacles in front of the flight path.

articleTitle: Dynamic Gesture Recognition Method Based on Improved DTW Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: An improved DTW algorithm is proposed by studying the features of dynamic gesture track. Using Kinect sensor to obtain the fingertip position in time, construct the angle vector feature to describe the movement track of the fingertip. Relaxation the endpoint limit resolves the problem that the gesture sequence is not aligned with the candidate sequence endpoint, an improved ET-DTW algorithm is obtained by using the early termination matching strategy to reduce the unnecessary amount of computation. At the same time, the candidate sequences were sorted by LB_Keogh lower bound function to further optimize the algorithm. Experiments show that the accuracy and recognition speed of dynamic gesture recognition are greatly improved compared with the traditional DTW algorithm.

articleTitle: Model Predictive Current Control with Duty Cycle Optimization for Two-Level Three-Phase Grid-Tied Inverter with Output LCL Filter Based on Forward Euler Approximation
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: This paper proposes a model predictive current control (MPCC) by using a duty cycle for a three-phase inverter connected to the grid Optimization based on Forward Euler approximation. To achieve much better steady state performance, in the prior model predictive current control (MPCC), the discretetime system model is used to checks each of the 7 possible switching states to choose a state that minimizes the cost function. However, single voltage vector employed in one control period is extremely limited to decrease the current ripples to a minimum value. Hence, to obtain sufficient performance, the sampling frequency is necessary to choose high. In order to resolve this issue, a duty ratio optimization technique has been performed. According to the simulation results, the proposed MPCC obtain much better steady-state.

articleTitle: 3D Mapping of Multi-floor Buildings Based on Sensor Fusion
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: In this paper, we design a highly accurate method for 3D mapping of multi-floor buildings. The basic idea is to combine the laser range sensor for metric mapping and barometric pressure sensor for detecting floor transition and kinect sensor for collection 3D environment information. Meanwhile, we adopt the Monte Carlo localization in 2D map to improve the accuracy of the localization. Finally, the barometric pressure is used to merge the 3D map of the multi-floor buildings. By using the information collected by a real robot in a typical multi-floor environment, the method is tested and compared with some other approaches, the results show that the method is efficient and has a better result in 3D mapping of multi-floor buildings.

articleTitle: DBSCAN Algorithm Clustering for Massive AIS Data Based on the Hadoop Platform
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: With the rapid development of economy in central cities, Inland river traffic flow has grown rapidly, based on the vast amount of ship AIS information, there are a lot of inland river traffic characteristics. With the rapid growth of information and data, the size of AIS data has been as high as dozens of GB, and even can reach TB units, how to deal with such a huge amount of AIS data quickly is becoming more and more important. In this paper, aiming at the research of DBSCAN clustering of AIS data, and combining the Hadoop platform, a DBSACN clustering algorithm based on Hadoop platform for massive AIS data was put forward. the DBSCAN clustering algorithm is encapsulated under MapReduce parallel computing framework, through HDFS distributed storage and MapReduce distributed computing, which make full use of the advantages of Hadoop in dealing with big data and greatly improves the efficiency of the algorithm. The experimental results show that the proposed scheme can greatly improve the efficiency of DBSACN algorithm clustering processing AIS data and detect abnormal trajectory without reducing the quality of algorithm clustering.

articleTitle: Improved Ant Colony Optimization Algorithm for Intelligent Vehicle Path Planning
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: In order to overcome the shortcomings of original Ant Colony Optimization (ACO) algorithm, such as slow convergence speed and easily falling into the local optimum during solving path planning problem, an improved ACO algorithm is proposed by improving its heuristic function, pheromone allocation mechanism and path selection strategy. Simulation results show that the improved ACO algorithm is effective. In this paper, the improved ACO algorithm is applied to the intelligent vehicles path planning. In order to meet the requirements of the intelligent vehicle actual trajectory, the B-spline curve is used to smooth the path generated by the improved ACO algorithm. The path following simulations in CarSim software show that the actual vehicle trajectory can conform with the target path, and the vehicle can keep the handling stability.

articleTitle: The Application of Big Data in Higher Vocational Education Based on Holland Vocational Interest Theory
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: Students want to find major or profession that they are really interested in. However, most of them do not know how to make the decision. The VPI and SDS scales, which have been widely applied basing on Hollander's vocational interest theory, can help students to find the interest. However, the self-report scale has its own limitations. By means of constructing integration platform and standard database, we gain student behavior data in daily educational activities. Digging out the valuable part in these data and find the intrinsic link between the students' behavior, we can build students' growth behavior model, and predict the future development trend, which provides scientific guidance for school education. In this case, we can promote the construction of a more reasonable management system and more personalized curriculum system.

articleTitle: Open Industrial Knowledge Graph Development for Intelligent Manufacturing Service Matchmaking
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: Intelligent manufacturing service matchmaking requires the sharing and integration of manufacturing knowledge. In this paper, a collaborative development for open industrial knowledge graph is proposed to collect knowledge in four respects. Based on this, a tiered matchmaking procedure is proposed including feature matching, numeric matching and function matching.

articleTitle: Mobile Terminal Development Plan of Cross-Platform Mobile Application Service Platform Based on Ionic and Cordova
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: According to The current situation of high demand for mobile applications, combined with the mainstream and the current development trend of mobile information technology, three kinds of mobile application development are analyzed, based on the business process of an automobile company, the mobile terminal technology development plan of Cross - platform enterprise - class mobile application service platform is defined. Using Ionic and merging Angular JS as a UI framework; using the Cordova hybrid engine to achieve cross-platform and mobile device native interface calls; Development tools use WebStorm for front-end page development, and cross-platform application development process is described. The results show that the selected technology development plan of mobile terminal is feasible, it provides a mobile terminal solution for enterprises to integrate and unify the user experience, enhances the enterprise's ability to control the mobile information system, lays a solid foundation for enterprises to quickly and efficiently achieve mobile information.

articleTitle: Research on the Improvement of HHT Algorithm in the Analysis of End Effect in Power System Harmonic Process
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: With the rapid development of modern industry, the high power thyristor converter circuit, power electronic rectifier, converter module and other nonlinear loads are widely used, resulting in the harmonic problem in the power grid which is becoming more and more serious. Based on three typical features of the analysis method of harmonic comprehensive comparison on the inhibition by adaptive waveform matching extension method for end effects of HHT algorithm, the feasibility and effectiveness of the improved algorithm is verified by the comparison of analog signals before and after using the improved algorithm results.

articleTitle: Innovation Research on the Emerging Engineering Talent Cultivation Mode in the Era of Industry 4.0
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: Since industry 4.0 era speeds up the transformation and upgrading of China's manufacturing industry, it needs a large number of top-notch innovative talents in the emerging engineering disciplines. This research studies cases of the United States, Germany and other developed countries by the method of case analysis. Based on the environment of carrying out the construction of emerging Engineering in universities, this paper puts forward talent cultivation mode of the "Order-based" learning, diversified learning, innovative learning and international learning. In the talent cultivation mode, innovative entrepreneurship education and "double qualified" teachers are focused on. The mode is to meet the talent goal of industry 4.0 era, to improve ability of engineering practice and to shape the core competitiveness of the industry.

articleTitle: The Attitude Control of Transmission Line Fault Inspection UAV Based on ADRC
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: Transmission lines are important part of the power system, the safety of line equipment is related to the stability of the power system. Transmission line fault inspection is a basic work to ensure the safety of line equipment. With the rapid development of unmanned aerial vehicles(UAV), the UAV equipped with detection sensors is used for line fault inspection. It is a new type of inspection, which has the advantages of higher security, greater efficiency, more freedom, and lower consumption. This paper does research on the attitude control of the inspection UAV, and designs an auto disturbance rejection control (ADRC) controller, then performs the simulation experiments to show that the ADRC controller has good control effect on the UAV flight attitude. Considering the UAV may suffer from different types of wind interference in the process of performing tasks, this paper has conducted simulation experiment during different wind interference environment, such as, gust, gradual wind, persistent wind and random wind. The ADRC controller's simulation effect is better than PID and the ADRC controller is verified of excellent wind-interference performance.

articleTitle: Face Recognition Research Based on the Fusion of Layered LBP Feature
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: Local Binary Pattern(LBP) is an operator to describe the local texture of face, which has the characteristics of rotation invariance and grayscale invariance. This paper proposed a face recognition arithmetic based on the fusion of layered LBP feature(F-LLBP), using the LBP operator to extract the layered texture feature, fusing the characteristics of each layer, reducing the dimension with Principal Component Analysis and Linear Discriminant Analysis(PCA-LDA) to get a set of low dimensional characteristic which are easy to classify, finally using the KNN arithmetic to classify. The experiments on ORL face database verifies the effectiveness of the F-LLBP, the experimental results indicate that the recognition rate of FLLBP increased 8% relative to the traditional LBP feature combined with PCA dimension reduction arithmetic.

articleTitle: Feedback Control of Fractional PIλDµ for DC/DC Buck Converters
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: To deal with the problem of ripple and instability occurred in the class DC Buck converter when its load and component parameters change or the feedback loop is disturbed by the outside, a fractional order controller(FOC) is designed in this paper to realize high performance control of Buck circuits. Compared with the traditional PID controller, this controller introduces two fractional parameters λ and μ. Combining fractional order theory with PID controller, the fractional PID feedback loop is established to improve the control effect of the system on the output voltage. The fractional order control strategy is simulated. Simulation results show that this fractional order control has the advantages of better dynamic and steady-state performance, stronger anti-interference ability and stronger robustness.

articleTitle: MSER and Connected Domain Analysis Based Algorithm for Container Code Locating Process
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: Effective and efficient automatic container code recognition is an essential component of intelligent port management. Higher sensitivity and intelligence are required in container code locating process. Based on the edge of container code area and the color of the container surface, a container code locating algorithm based on Maximally Stable Extremal Region (MSER) and connected domain analysis is proposed in this paper. This algorithm is an efficient algorithm of container code characters location in complex scenes. Then, this paper further proposed a strategy to combine multiple algorithms. The correct rate under the algorithm combination strategy reached 97.19%, and the time is within 0.6s, effectively adapt to the diversity and code permutation of container code permutation, significantly improve the positioning ability of the container, which can meet the requirement of real time in practical application.

articleTitle: Particle Swarm Optimization with Gaussian Disturbance
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) is a population-based heuristic algorithm with fast speed in many complicated problems. However PSO easily falls into local optima because of the attraction from the best particle in velocity updating formula. This paper proposes an improved PSO with Gaussian disturbance (GDPSO) to solve this problem by adding a Gaussian chaos on the best particle to lead the swarm flies away from dilemma. Experimental results on some well-known benchmark problems have shown that GDPSO could successfully handle with those difficult functions while maintaining fast search speed.

articleTitle: Sequential Monte Carlo Reliability Prediction Method of Low Voltage Distribution Network Based on Failure Effect Analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: In order to predict the reliability of low voltage distribution network, an improved algorithm based on the traditional sequential Monte Carlo method is proposed. In this method, the basic data and operation data of low voltage power network are used to calculation parameters of each branch's and equipment's failure rate, outage time and failure effects. By combining sequential Monte Carlo method, the reliability of low voltage distribution network is predicted. This paper also put forward the measures to improve the power supply reliability of low voltage distribution network, including replacing the old line equipment, adding the sectional switch and installing the contact switch. The results show that the method proposed in this paper can be applied to the reliability prediction of low voltage distribution network.

articleTitle: A New Method of Shredded Paper Image Stitching and Restoration
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: For the image restoration problem of shredded paper broken by shredder with the same marginal feature, a new method based on spatial feature classification is proposed in this paper. Because no obvious marginal feature for rule shredder paper can be used to split, the feature similarity classification processing can greatly reduce the solution scale and improve the algorithm efficiency. The horizontal projection position of shredded paper image can be used to distinguish the same line for the shredded paper with words. Then the marginal moment invariants distance are defined by the left and right part spatial correlation information. The original order of adjacent shredded paper in the same line can be ensured by the minimum marginal distance. Similarly ordering up and down can be completed by the minimum marginal distance among up-down part stitching images. For the image stitching and restoration of large-scale rule shredded paper, the actual experimental result shows the good stability, efficiency and strong robustness.

articleTitle: Algorithm of Fingertip Detection and Its Improvement Based on Kinect
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: Fingertip feature is the most important feature of gesture recognition, and fingertip detection is the core of the interactive system. Because of high requirement of fingertip information for video gesture recognition technology, a method of fingertip detection is proposed based on information of depth image and human skeleton. Firstly, the Kinect is chosen to carry out the collection of the depth image, then the hand is positioned, the image is preprocessed, the eight neighborhood tracking algorithm and a series of other algorithms are used to split the gestures. Then the shortcomings of traditional K-curvature fingertip detection algorithm are analyzed, and it combines with fast convex hull algorithm for fingertip recognition. Finally, an algorithm called "scan fitting method" is proposed to solve the problem of fingertip close detection.

articleTitle: LCL-type Grid-Connected Inverter Based on Fractional-Order PID Control
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: The main function of Grid-connected inverter is to convert the DC power to AC power with stably, generally, the quality of output power is controlled by the traditional PID controllers. However, some results of steady-state control with low precision and larger ripples appearing in this control process. Therefore, a new fractional order PID control strategy is proposed. The development of Fractional order PID controller is based on the traditional PID controller. Compared with traditional PID controller, the fractional order PID controller has two more adjustable parameter. It can be designed more flexibly and better performance. The simulation results show that the fractional order PID control strategy improves the steady - state accuracy of the output current of the grid - connected inverter obviously, besides, it has good control effectiveness, flexible structure, and strong ability of anti-interference.

articleTitle: Research on Product Attribute Extraction and Classification Method for Online Review
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: With the rapid development of e-commerce, a wide variety of product reviews have appeared on the internet. These reviews not only provide consumers with a reference, but also help manufacturers make reasonable marketing decisions. In online reviews, customers usually give opinions on multiple attributes of products, therefore, the analysis of product attributes is a crucial issue in product review analysis. This paper studies in depth the extraction and classification of product attribute words from the context. Aiming at the colloquial speech in the online review and the incompleteness of the existing dictionary-based word segmentation methods, this paper uses machine learning method to identify product attribute words. By introducing the word internal tag method to identify the segmented out-of-vocabulary attribute words, and add it to the user's dictionary, correcting the word segmentation results. In addition, a word-level text classification method based on distributed word representation is proposed, and the semantic and syntactic features of the word vectors are used to classify the product attribute words.

articleTitle: Kinematics Analysis and Trajectory Planning of Upper Limb Rehabilitation Robot
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: With the rapid development of robot technology, the application of medical rehabilitation robot is also increasing. The upper limb rehabilitation robot is contacted with patients directly, so the control of it require high robustness. In this paper, a three degree of freedom(DOF) upper limb rehabilitation robot is proposed. The relationship between the coordinates of each link of the rehabilitation robot is established, and the D-H parameters of the robot are obtained. Matlab Robotics toolbox is used to establish robot's model and analysis kinematics. Trajectory in the robot's joint coordinate is planned. Finally, a robot control model for upper limb rehabilitation is established. Using the algorithm to control the upper limb rehabilitation robot, the experiment results indicate that the three DOF upper limb rehabilitation robot control algorithm has a certain stability.

articleTitle: Design of PWM Rectifier Based on Fractional Order PID Control
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: Three-phase PWM rectifier is a strong non-linear, timevarying uncertain system, the use of traditional linear control method is difficult to achieve the desired control effect due to its poor dynamic performance and complex parameter design. In this paper, the three-phase PWM rectifier model is used as the controlled object, and the fractional order PID control system is realized by the optimal Oustaloup numerical algorithm. The fractional PID parameters are optimized. The simulation results show that the fractional order PID control system has better control quality and stronger robustness. Besides, it also satisfies the requirement of fast dynamic response and has practical application value.

Author Keywords: Three - phase Voltage Source PWM Rectifier

articleTitle: The Simulation Research of PMSM Control Based on MPC
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: MPC(Model predict Control) is an advanced kind of control strategy. The core idea is to make most use of the mathematical model of control object to minimize the cost function and obtain the optimal control signal. In this paper, a speed loop controller and a current loop controller are designed, based on the mathematical model of PMSM (Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor) and the theory of MPC, and a PMSM simulation model based on model predictive is established and compared with another one based on PI control.

articleTitle: Research on Collaborative Filtering Algorithm Based on Spark Platform
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of time-consuming and low accuracy in dealing with massive data using traditional collaborative filtering algorithm, this paper analyzes the principle of the Item-Based algorithm and the ALS algorithm and parallelizes the two algorithms based on the Spark platform. And fuse the two algorithms. Considering the parallelization performance of recommended algorithm and recommended quality, the comparison experiment were implemented on the open data set MovieLens. Experimental results show that even on a single node, the running time of each algorithm is far less than the traditional single machine implementation. The fusion of two kinds of collaborative filtering algorithms can further improve the recommendation accuracy on the basis of the existing algorithms.

articleTitle: The Application of Improved Camshift Algorithm in Hand Tracking
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: Camshift algorithm is often used in hand tracking. The traditional Camshift algorithm can realize hand tracking in simple condition, but it is easy to fail to track when similar color background interference and occlusion happens. In order to solve the problem, a kind of improved Camshift algorithm is proposed. Background subtraction algorithm based on mixed gaussian model is used to extract movement information of hand; then combine the color feature with movement feature by adopting an adaptive method to improve the algorithm. In the meantime, the Kalman filter algorithm is used to predict the location of hand, so the hand can be tracked accurately when it is covered. The experimental results show that improved Camshift algorithm can accurately track the hand when similar color background interference and occlusion happens, and improve the robustness of hand tracking.

articleTitle: A HFC-based Bayesian Network Structure Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: For the problem that Bayesian network structure learning algorithm is easy to fall into local optimum, this paper proposes a scoring search method based on HFC (Hierarchical Fair Competition) model. It divides the population into different grades according to its fitness, and carries on the evolutionary method of intra class competition and inter level migration to ensure the diversity of the population in the process of evolution and avoid the search into the local optimum. At the same time, the mutual information theory and BIC (Bayesian Information Criterion) scoring criterion are used to calculate the initial network structure, reduce the search space and shorten the search time. Finally, the algorithm is used to study the network structure of the classical data sets--Asia, and the results show the decrease in the number of extra edges and missing edges which better describe the network structure contained in the data.

articleTitle: Research on Quantitative Computation Method of Elevator Safety Accident Based on Risk Perception
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: From the perspective of risk perception, this paper analyze hierarchy process (AHP) and fuzzy evaluation method to divide the elevator related people into five categories: producers, operators, regulators, social public and specialized technical personnel in elevator. Moreover, according the risk perception characteristics of each category and its proportion in social groups, it establishes a three level evaluation level evaluation index system of influencing factors of risk perception, and analyzes in detail the key factors that cause risk perception mutation. Then establishes the quantitative calculation method of risk perception of elevator safety accident to analyze and calculate the risk perception process of elevator safety. Therefore, it can provide theoretical and method support in the prevention, early warning, rescue, evaluation and other related management work of elevator safety accident.

articleTitle: Research on Harmonic Compensation of Distribution Network with High Permeability Access of New Energy Power Generation
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: The depletion of traditional fossil fuels has brought about a constant increase in pressure on the global environment. Owing to fast penetration of power electronics devices, several loads within distributed generation systems are nonlinear. As a result, renewable energy generation such as wind turbine (WT) and Solar Photovoltaic (PV) introduce new challenges to the distribution system, such as harmonic instability that needs attention. Harmonic current is among the most vital sources of disturbance, causing deterioration of the effectiveness of electronic equipment. However, the inherent harmonic caused by these power electronic devices can have an effect on the power system voltage and subsequently customer equipment. For this reason, a research on harmonic current compensation is important. Shunt active power filters based LLCL to analyze the harmonics currents created by the power electronic devices in new energy generation is presented here. Specific harmonics compensation in the power system is performed under synchronous coordinate transformation. The distinctive features of this design are motivated by the provision of effective DC utilization, high performance in relations to mitigation of harmonic current and offer precisely controlled output current. The effective compensation and suppression of reactive power and harmonics in the power grid enhance the quality of power supply in the network. The research proposed is verified by MATLAB/Simulink.

articleTitle: The Application of HVDC Transmission in Shore Power Supply
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: In order to avoid the pollution by the emission of ships which docked in port, the shore power has become a trend. Nowadays, most of the electric power generation, transmission, distribution and consumption of high level are in alternating current form, so the HVAC transmission becomes the selection of shore power supply. However, put aside the great influence of HVAC on the environment, AC cables are also affected by reactive currents during transmission, which would reduce the power transmission capability of cables; and the transmission lines can also form a large capacitance with surrounding media (seawater, soil), which would affect the stable operation of the power grid. While HVDC transmission does not have this problem, the DC transmission system is formed by non-reactive DC circuit to connect two AC system, the conveying capacity and distance are not limited by the stability of synchronous operation, it can realize the non synchronous interconnection of the power grid. According to the development trend of power transmission, this paper searched an application of HVDC transmission in the shore power supply.

articleTitle: Design of Loading and Unloading Manipulator End Effector for Shaft Parts
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: In view of the disadvantages of the low-level automation, low efficiency and high cost in the traditional mechanical processing industry, the loading and unloading manipulator is designed for φ50mm shaft parts. The whole structure design of the manipulator is completed. A kind of end effector which is used to clamp the shaft parts is designed, and the clamping force and the opening-closing velocity are calculated. As the main components, the sun gear is analyzed by finite element method. With compact structure, high transmission efficiency and convenient maintenance, this design has a broad market prospect.

articleTitle: Research on Reactive Power Optimization Algorithm of Power System Based on Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: Reactive power optimization of power system is an effective means to ensure the safety and economic operation of the system. It is an important measure to reduce the power loss and improve the power quality. In this paper, an Improved Genetic Algorithm (IGA) is proposed to solve the problem that the Simple Genetic Algorithm (SGA) is inefficient in the application of power system reactive power optimization. IGA has improved the coding method, fitness function, initial population generation, crossover and mutation strategy, and improves the computational efficiency and global optimization ability. In this paper, the IEEE14 node system is simulated in MATLAB environment. The results show that IGA improves the convergence ability and convergence speed, and effectively reduces the active power loss of the power system.

articleTitle: Fractional Order PID Control Strategy for Modular Multilevel Converters
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: In order to simplify the control of the modular multilevel converter and reduce the harmonic component in the circulation, I propose a fractional order PID control method. And I build a state equation of the single-phase equivalent circuit of the modular multilevel converter. Then According to the analysis of the state equation, we need to adjust the total voltage of the input by a fractional-order PID to obtain a circulation reference. Finally, I let the circulation reference and the load current reference as the input of deadbeat control. Compared with the traditional integer-order PID control method, the dynamic response of the circulation reference that based on the fractional-order PID control method proposed in this paper is better and can be stabilized more quickly. What is more, the harmonic component of circulation and the capacitor voltage ripple of sub-module are lower. So the method proposed in this paper is effective.

articleTitle: Research on Energy Efficiency Evaluation of Medium and Low Voltage Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: Based on the research status of energy distribution index of distribution network, a set of energy efficiency index system of medium and low voltage distribution network was established according to the relevant standard and the practical operability. The index system of the construction covers the evaluation index of distribution network planning, equipment parameters and equipment operation status. The calculation method of single energy efficiency index is determined and the comprehensive evaluation model of distribution network energy efficiency based on AHP and principal component analysis is proposed. The effectiveness and feasibility of the evaluation method are verified by an example. The model is helpful to optimize the energy saving potential of the distribution network, and to optimize the allocation of energy - saving technological transformation and to improve the energy efficiency of the distribution network.

Author Keywords: medium and low voltage distribution network

articleTitle: Optimal Manufacturing/Remanufacturing Production Decision for Short Life-Cycle Products with Uncertain of Product Update-Cycle
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: Driven by the fierce market competition, manufacturing companies have to upgrade their products constantly to meet the growing market demand. The change of the update-cycle brings a great deal of uncertainty to the manufacturing/remanufacturing hybrid system, which makes production decision more difficult. To solve this problem, we establish a hybrid manufacturing/remanufacturing production decision model with stable market environment and uncertain update-cycle for life-cycle products. And a new hybrid algorithm combined genetic algorithm and artificial fish-swarm algorithm with chaos search strategy is proposed to get an optimal hybrid manufacturing/remanufacturing production decision. Finally, a case study is addressed to verify the rationality and validity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: An Exploration on Reform Path of Waste Management in China with Bayesian Modeling
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: In China, along with urbanization, population growth and industrialization, the quantity of municipal solid waste (MSW) generation has been increasing rapidly. This paper aims to examine the factors that influence the behavior of agents regarding waste management. Based on some Bayesian Network constructed for waste management, some reform path have been discovered. This paper also considers the key point and convertible option in these paths. Some suggestions are made aimed at improving the waste management system.

articleTitle: A Discrete Fruit Fly Optimization Algorithm for Traveling Salesman Problem
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: A discrete fruit fly optimization algorithm (DFOA) is proposed to solve the traveling salesman problem(TSP). To apply the basic FOA to the discrete domain, some improvement is made to ensure the global optimization ability. A numerous of tests based on standard benchmark instances are employed to test the performance of the DFOA. Simultaneously, the results compared with simulated annealing prove that DFOA is a efficient algorithm to solve TSP.

articleTitle: Research on Impact Factors of User's Continuance Intention in Online Education Platform
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet technology in China, digital online learning has become a new way for people to receive education. The scale of online education users has been growing rapidly as well as online education industry, which has broad and large market prospects. Many online education enterprises began to consider an important issue that how to attract and maintain users and make online education become more commercial. Under the backgrounds, this study takes the commercial online education platform as the research object, and based on previous researches, it integrates Echnology Acceptance Model (EAM), Expectation Confirmation Model (ECM) and Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology (UTAUT), and constructs impact factors model. Based on the results, this study also puts forward some targeted operational strategies to improve the user's intention.

Author Keywords: unified theory of acceptance and use of technology

articleTitle: The Research of DPFC Considering EEAC
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: In this paper, the distributed power flow controller which belongs to the new generation of flexible AC transmission equipment is briefly introduced. The extended equal area criterion is used to study the transient stability of the distributed power flow controller, and the influences of the distributed power flow controller on the extended equal area criterion are analyzed. The equivalent model of the distributed power flow controller is built on the ADPSS software platform. The simulation results verify that this equivalent model is adaptable to extended equal area criterion method. And the method can be used to analysis distributed power flow controller's transient stability.

articleTitle: Particle Swarm Optimization Using Levy Distribution for Economic Load Dispatch Problem
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: Economic Load Dispatch (ELD) problem is an important optimization problem in power system and has attracted researchers' attention. This paper presents particle swarm optimization (PSO) using Levy distribution (LDPSO) to solve ELD problem with valve point effect. Levy distribution has an infinite second moment with heavy tail. Through adding Levy distribution disturbance in the global position of PSO, it can avoid falling into local optimum and increase the performance of PSO algorithm. The paper introduces the implementation method of LDPSO in detail. The proposed algorithm is used to solve 13 units ELD problem with valve point effect. The results shows that LDPSO can successfully find optimum solution and maintain fast search speed.

articleTitle: Analysis of Route Optimization Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: In the logistics system, distribution process plays a very important role, whether the distribution route was reasonable arranged influences the cost of distribution and benefit. The optimization of the route is affected by the customer's address and delivery time. Minimizing the transportation cost is the purpose of this paper when satisfying the customer's requirement. On this basis, the traffic conditions are introduced to optimize the distribution route, and the effectiveness of the algorithm is tested and verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Fault Detection Method Based on Moving Window Principal Component Analysis for Three-Tank System
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: In this paper, a fault detection method based on moving window principal component analysis (MWPCA) is introduced. This method is applied to the three-tank system, and three typical faults of three water tank system are detected. The results show that the MWPCA has better performance compared with the traditional principal component analysis(PCA) method.

articleTitle: Fault Warning of Hydro-Generator Based on Fisher Criterion
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: As the most mature technology and the most economical clean energy in the global energy supply, hydropower occupies an important position. There are many factors of safety and stable operation in the hydropower station, and equipment failure will bring huge economic losses, so the warning of equipment failure in the hydropower station has played a crucial role. This paper summarizes the principle of NSET modeling method for nonlinear state estimation. And the data is processed using feature selection based on Fisher criterion, then use NSET to simulate the hydro-generator, and select the characteristic state parameter of its key components as reference. When the residual value exceeds the pre-set, it issued a warning message, prompting the operator to check the equipment status.

articleTitle: Research on MPPT Algorithm Based on Variable-Step Conductance Increment Method and Pseudo-MPP Correction
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: Aiming at the problems that the traditional conductance increment method requires a large number of differential calculations to track the maximum power point(MPP), and the step sign is incorrectly judged when the illumination intensity suddenly decreases, an improved MPPT algorithm based on variable-step conductance increment method and pseudo-MPP correction is proposed. The variable-step conductance increment method is used to track the pseudo-MPP quickly in the first stage, then in the second stage the pseudo-MPP is corrected. In addition, by setting the current mutation threshold to judge the sign of the step size when the external conditions have strong fluctuation. The system model of photovoltaic(PV) is built on Matlab / Simulink simulation platform. Results between the improved algorithm and the traditional algorithm show that the proposed algorithm has the higher tracking accuracy, better stability and dynamic characteristics.

articleTitle: Research for Equivalent Mathematical Model of MMC-DPFC
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: In order to improve the applied voltage level of DPFC parallel side, this paper introduces MMC into the parallel side of DPFC, and puts forward a DPFC based on MMC, abbreviated as MMC-DPFC, which has the advantages of easy modularization, easy expansion of capacity and increase of voltage level, easy batch production, small footprint and so on. First, for the inadequacy of existing facts devices, the topological structure of MMC-DPFC is put forward, and for the features of MMC-DPFC, the equivalent mathematical model of MMC-DPFC is put forward to simplify the electromagnetic transient simulation of MMC-DPFC on ADPSS simulation platform, and the control strategy to meet the requirements of the system is put forward by analyzing the principle of MMC-DPFC. Finally, in the ADPSS simulation platform, the simulation model of double line transmission system with MMC-DPFC equivalent mathematic model is built, and the validity and correctness of the equivalent mathematic model are proved by simulation experiment, and the MMC-DPFC device has good efficiency and controllability in the control system flow.

articleTitle: Windows Open Status Detection for Boxcar in Railway Transportation Based on Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: In railway transportation, the windows of boxcar may be opened because of the damage of locking structure or the bumps and vibration of the vehicle body. This fault will seriously affect the safety of the transportation. To recognize the fault timely, a fault recognition algorithm based on computer vision is proposed. First, according to the boxcar body structure, the body is segmented from the images on both sides of the boxcar. Second, the candidate inner window area is extracted by line detection and hierarchical clustering for the lines. Finally, The SVM classifier is used to detect the outer window with an elliptical structure, and the open status of windows is determined by the spatial correlation between the outer window and the inner. 3000+ images of boxcar are used to verify the algorithm and the results show that the algorithm can accurately detect the open status of windows for boxcar.

articleTitle: Multiple-Population Jaya Algorithm for Continuous Function Optimization
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: In order to improve population diversity, multiple-population jaya algorithm (MPJA) is introduced. The population is divided into several sub-populations and each sub-population is evolved independently by using its own best solution and the worst solution. Local search is applied to intensify the local search ability of MPJA. Extensive experiments are conducted on 10 test functions. The experimental result show that MPJA has advantages on computational accuracy and global search ability.

articleTitle: An Evolutionary Many-Objective Optimization Algorithm Based on Coverage and Cache Strategy
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: How to balance the diversity and convergence plays an important role on the performance of a multiobjective evolutionary optimizer. Due to the loss of selection pressure and the exponential expansion in the high-dimensional objective space, it is even more difficult for an optimizer to balance between convergence and diversity for a many-objective optimization problem. To address this issue, in this paper, we propose a cache mechanism to improve the convergence and a coverage-based method for maintaining better diversity. Based on these two mechanisms, a many-objective evolutionary algorithm is further proposed. The experimental studies are conducted to verify the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Research on Two-Dimensional Entropy Threshold Method Based on Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: Image segmentation has always been the difficulty and focus in image processing research. The traditional best histogram threshold method is not ideal for segmentation of images. This paper presents a modified method of two-dimensional entropy threshold method and its improved genetic algorithm. Compared with the traditional entropy threshold method, the two-dimensional entropy threshold method not only reflects the gray-level distribution information, but also reflects the image pixel neighborhood spatial correlation information, greatly improving the image segmentation effect. At the same time, the improved genetic algorithm is used to solve the problem that the traditional genetic algorithm has slow convergence and improper threshold selection. This algorithm improves the threshold search speed and effect.

articleTitle: Bayesian Test with Quadratic Criterion for Multiple Hypothesis Testing Problem
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: A Bayesian test has been previously proposed for a multiple hypothesis testing (MHT) problem with a quadratic loss function such that this problem can fit with some real applications where the concurrent hypotheses should be distinguished. However, this MHT problem as well as this quadratic loss function are insufficient for some other applications such as the simultaneous intrusion detection and localization in a wireless sensor network (WSN). This kind of applications could be considered as a MHT problem with null hypothesis. Therefore, a Bayesian test with a modified quadratic loss function is proposed to solve this MHT problem. The non-asymptotic bounds for analyzing the performance of the proposed test and the Bayesian test with the 0-1 loss function are obtained, from which the conditional asymptotic equivalence between these two tests is then theoretically established. The effectiveness of these bounds and the analysis on the conditional asymptotic equivalence are verified by the simulation results.

articleTitle: Research on Energy Management Strategy of Dual Power Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: Based on high power density and fast charging and discharging rate of Supercapacitor, the hybrid power system of lithium battery and Supercapacitor dual power source is proposed and designed. And the energy management strategy based on fuzzy PID algorithm is studied to realize the power distribution between Supercapacitor and lithium battery. The results of simulation show that power allocation is reasonable, and Supercapacitor can satisfy the demand of the instantaneous dynamic loading, at the same time it undertakes most of the current fluctuations, thus protecting the lithium battery.

articleTitle: Research on the Interaction between the Series Inverters of Distributed Power Flow Controller
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: To research the interaction and factors of the series inverters of the distributed power flow controller, the structure and the control principle of the series inverters are discussed in detail. The simulation is conducted in four sections, which are divided in the choice of target value, the given time of the target value, the electric distance and the number of the series inverters. It was the factors that revealed in these experiments, and how the factors influence is explained. In all, these are foundation of the application in the actual power grid of the distributed power flow controller.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Temperature Controller for Thermocouple Automatic Calibrating Furnace
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: According to the national regulations of the calibrating regulation of industrial metal thermocouples and calibrating regulation of working with precious metal thermocouples, an intelligent temperature controller for thermocouple automatic calibrating system is designed based on single chip microcomputer AT89C52. This controller adopts the fuzzy self-tuning PID control algorithm to control the temperature of the resistance furnace which meets the required temperature test point to form a uniform temperature field in order to realize the automatic calibrating of the thermocouple. The simulation results show that the fuzzy self-tuning PID control has many advantage such as better stability, small overshoot, high steady-state accuracy and almost no steady-state error, etc., compared with the traditional PID control algorithm. So the intelligent temperature controller can meet the control requirements of the temperature control system of the calibrating furnace.

articleTitle: Impedance Control of Upper Limb Rehabilitation Robot Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: The upper limb rehabilitation robot is in direct contact with the patient, so the control of the robot needs to be compliant. In this paper, an impedance control method of three degree of freedom upper limb rehabilitation robot is proposed. In the impedance control model, the force between the patients and machine is simplified into a spring damping system. The neural network PID is used to control the robot to achieve the desired trajectory. The learning function of neural network can adjust parameters of PID online which enables the impedance control method to control the metabolic system. Finally, the test results show that the impedance control method has certain superiority.

articleTitle: An Improved Case Retrieval Method For the Production Manufacturing Process of Aluminum Electrolysis
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: In production manufacturing process of aluminum electrolysis, the similarity analysis of production working status plays an important role in improving the economy and objectivity of management. In this paper, a case-based reasoning (CBR) system is proposed to retrieval the similar cases classification. There are two problems in applying standard CBR for production manufacturing process of aluminum electrolysis, which are the abundance of different types of attributes and reasonable weight learning method. To solve these problems, an improved case retrieval method is proposed in detail. The model is mainly focus on the heterogeneous value distance metric and multiple weights combination. Finally, the application result indicates that the proposed method is superior to traditional CBR and other classified methods. The evaluation result indicates the potential of the improved CBR system in the production manufacturing process of aluminum electrolysis.

articleTitle: Study on Temporal and Spatial Variation Characteristics and Factors of Concentration of Atmospheric Inhalable Particles
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: This paper researched the temporal and spatial variation characteristics of PM10 concentration, the correlation with PM10 concentration and the concentration of major pollutants and meteorological parameters, and established a multiple linear regression model between PM10 concentration and these influencing parameters. The experimental results show that PM10 concentration is roughly related to the concentration of CO and SO2, and the correlation with the meteorological parameters is not obvious.

articleTitle: User Interest Feature Extraction and Recognition Based on LBS
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: The description, extraction and identification of user interest characteristics based on LBS can be used to build a location-dependent user interest model [1] to provide location-based personalized advertising referral services. Based on the data provided by Baidu map advertising department, the user data of LBS is used to describe and extract the user's interest. The feature weighting algorithm is designed to improve the interest point recognition model and dig the user's point of interest. The experiment is based on the method designed in this paper from the map to obtain the 100,000 data. The experimental results show that compared with the improved SVM recognition model, this paper improves the SVM feature weighted point recognition model, adds the weight to the original feature, and improves the accuracy of the test data from 70.8% to 72.1%. And further introduces the search result feature on the basis of the feature-weighted SVM, the accuracy of the test data is further increased to 87.3%.

articleTitle: Supplier Selection on the Basis of Green Innovation Ability
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: With the awareness of global environmental protection and green consumption have penetrated throughout the world, the subject of green supply chain management has increasingly caught the attention from both researchers and practitioners. Recognizing the importance of supplier selection in a green supply chain, this study aims at selecting suppliers on the basis of their green innovation ability. In this study, a methodology is designed to select an optimal supplier based on the analytic network process (ANP). A numerical example is provided as a guideline for its application in supplier selection. The result demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Water Quality Evaluation of a Certain Section of Yangtze River Based on Fuzzy Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: Due to the complexity of the process of water pollution, there are limitations in the traditional water quality evaluation methods. In this paper, the water quality is analyzed and evaluated by using the T-S fuzzy neural network model and the data of water quality monitoring in the last three years from January 2014 to February 2017 in a certain city of Yangtze River. The results show that the compliance rate of Grade III water quality is 100% in the Yangtze River from the beginning of 2014 to the beginning of 2017, and the trend of water quality rating is consistent with the real data index, which shows the effectiveness and advantages of fuzzy neural network.

articleTitle: Keynotes
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: Provides an abstract for each of the keynote presentations and may include a brief professional biography of each presenter. The complete presentations were not made available for publication as part of the conference proceedings.

articleTitle: Analysis and Comparison of Various Speed Control Strategies on the Performance of DC Motor
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: This paper presents the effect of different speed control strategies on the speed response of a DC motor. The mathematical models are built on the basis of the analysis of operation modes and structural characteristics in the environment of matlab/simulink, mechanical characteristic and torque characteristic of DC motor are also concerned in this work. By analyzing and comparing the merits and shortcomings, the appropriate applicable condition of different speed control strategies can be concluded, which in turn optimizes actual controller and offers reasonable choice of electronic unit parameters.

articleTitle: Automatic Tuning Control System of Passive Harmonic Filtering Energy Saving Device
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: Based on harmonic characteristics of time-dependent load for harmonic source and the passive dynamic harmonic filter energy saving device, a set of automatic tuning control system of passive harmonic filter energy saving device is designed. This system can effectively track the change of component parameters and power grid frequency by closed-loop feedback control method, and the filtering effect of passive dynamic harmonic filter energy saving device is always optimized. The harmonics of the power grids will be suppressed. And the power consumption of the equipment would be reduced as well.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Video Detection and Tracking Platform for Inland Waterway Vessel Based on Hadoop
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: Inland waterway vessel video has a very important role in the automated management of inland waterways. However, there is currently no open platform for implementing video processing of inland waterway vessels. According to the characteristics of large video and video formats of inland vessel, the paper proposes to build a standard video library for inland vessel and establish a video processing platform for inland vessels based on Hadoop, which adopts B/S architecture, with Html, CSS and JavaScript as front desk technology, JSP, Servlet and JavaBean as background processing technology, and realizes the function of online processing video. Compared with the traditional stand-alone mode, HDFS provides a parallel computing model, Map Reduce, and a distributed file system called Hadoop. It realizes the parallel processing of inland river vessel video processing, improves the speed of inland river vessel video tracking and detection, and shortens the running time of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Bidirectional Wireless Power Transfer Charger for Power Bank
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: In this study, a bidirectional wireless power transfer (BWPT) charger for power banks (for sending and receiving power) was developed. The proposed DSP430L MCU improves the security and stability of the circuit and it can also switch between the discharging and charging modes. We also designed a high-frequency bidirectional AC-DC, DC-DC converter, AC-voltage, current, and phase detection circuit. We present an algorithm commonly used for BWPT in power banks and the charger is controlled by pulse frequency modulation with a constant width. The feasibility of the proposed method was verified by simulation results.

articleTitle: Review of the Present Situation and Development of Marine Diesel Engine
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: In this paper, the development status of marine diesel engine technology at home and abroad is discussed. The problems in the development of marine diesel engine industry are analyzed emphatically, and the future development trend of marine diesel engine is pointed out.

articleTitle: A Folding Contraction Method for Community Partition Detection
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: Recently, network topology has become a pop research field in complex networks. The small-world and scalefree character can be used in community detection. In this paper, we propose a folding contraction method (FCM) for community partition detection based on scale-free networks feature. And a framework of this method has been provided. Experimental results show that the proposed method has high accuracy and good performance.

articleTitle: Simulation of System Commissioning Test for UHVDC Converter Station
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: In order to make the commissioning of the UHVDC converter station successful and secure, the PSASP power system software tool was applied to simulate the switching test of unloaded lines, the 66kV reactors, the 66kV capacitors and the 500kV reactive power compensation equipments. All of the simulations were performed smoothly and the results are promising. Thus, they can be used to select the test limit, providing the basis for calculation, which provides reliable technical basis for the future analysis and control of UHVDC converter station system commissioning test in the future.

articleTitle: A SABC-based Image Feature Point Matching Method
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: An Artificial Bee Colony Algorithm (ABC for short) based feature matching method is proposed in this article. The process for seeking for optimal honey source in the ABC algorithm is adopted to simulate feature matching. Four honey source generation constraints are proposed based on possible matching results; in addition, the epipolar geometry constraint is introduced to design for the formula of fitness. Besides, aiming at disadvantages of the conventional ABC algorithm such as the local optimum due to "early-maturing", the simulated annealing (SA for short) algorithm is introduced for improvement, referred to as SABC. Based on experimental results, the matching algorithm proposed in this article achieves favorable results on instantaneity and accuracy.

articleTitle: The Identification of Multivariable Systems Based on a New Two-Stage Hierarchical Least-Squares Iterative Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: In this paper, a multivariable system with moving average noises can be expressed as a multivariable CARMA model. To solve the difficulty of the information matrix including unknown noise terms, the noise is estimated by fitting a high order CAR model by using the hierarchical least-squares iterative (HLSI) method. Based on the obtained noise, a modified HLSI method for identification of multivariable systems is proposed. It consists of two-stage HLSI method which can be on line applied to the identification of multivariable systems, and has fast convergence rate. Some simulations illustrate the effective of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: MEMS/NEMS and Their Applications in Internet of Things, Energy Harvesting, Sensors and Actuators
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: Microelectromechanical Systems (also known as 'Microsysetms') has been a multidisciplinary research topic since 1960s. It has attracted interesting applications in several major areas, such in energy sector, bioscience and communication industry. They have clear advantages of very small dimensions and low power consumptions. Some successful devices have already been developed in the commercial market. In the recent 20 years, following the developing trend of CMOS industry, the size of micrometer devices has been further reduced to the range of nanometres, hence a new concept, NEMS (nanoelectromechanical systems) has been introduced, which resulted in many high-quality publications devoted in nanoscale devices. Given that more interesting phenomena of micro&nano devices were unveiled, applying MEMS/NEMS in many other areas is inevitable. For the aim of developing novel micro/nano devices, we have been working on the following topics. 1) Developing novel micro/nano energy harvesting devices (including piezoelectric energy harvesters from mechanical movements, and thermoelectric devices). 2) Multiphysical modelling of nanoscale devices and structures. 3) Exploitation of micro sensors and actuators in practical applications. This talk will introduce various applications for MEMS/NEMS and our research activities in the above mentioned directions.

articleTitle: Study of Howling Suppression Based on FPGA and Wavelet Packet Transform
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: The phenomenon of howling is widespread in the acoustic amplification system. In order to suppress the cause of howling in the amplification system, the paper proposes the study of howling suppression on the FPGA by using wavelet packet transform: through the analysis of WM8731 and FPGA hardware module and on the basis of the hardware modules form the FPGA system of whole software framework, using the idea of top-down design in the software QUARTUSII, design and simulate each module respectively, and then download design of the whole howling suppression system to hardware platform. The design of the howling suppression based on FPGA complete.

articleTitle: A New Type of Power Supply System for Automotive Thermoelectric Power Generation Research on Optimal Control Strategy of Weak Hybrid Power
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: In recent years, the use of thermoelectric devices to transfer waste heat from exhaust gas to electricity power by thermoelectric conversion has become an international front topic for energy achieving and emission reduction. It has important theoretical and practical value. In this paper, by using the Dong-Feng Truck, design an integrated starter generator weak hybrid power system structure based on thermoelectric conversion, and put forward to the minimum fuel consumption as the target function of the system structure design and energy allocation optimization by the analysis of the condition of energy and power, finish the text of ISG weak hybrid power system, analyze the input and output characteristics of the on-board thermoelectric system, prove the significant improvement of the fuel economy by the hybrid energy management based on thermoelectric power generation.

articleTitle: The Study of the Optimal Three Wind Distribution in Biomass Boiler
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: The research object in this paper is a new biomass environmental protection boiler producted by some chongqing energy-saving equipment company. Firstly, the influence factors of combustion process were analyzed, then on this basis, the effect of the wind distribution control on combustion efficiency is mainly studied in this paper. For the unique characteristic of three wind distribution, which is owned by the new biomass environmental protection boiler, an optimal method of the three wind distribution based on fuzzy adaptive PID was put forward. The method makes boiler realize automatic fully, online search for the optimal operating mode, further achieve the effect of energy conservation and emissions reduction, green environmental protection. The study provides a theoretical basis for the new biomass environmental protection boiler to be intelligent, environmental protection.

articleTitle: A Study of Exoskeleton Walking Aids Device
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: Among the disabled people, patients with lower limb disability account for a large proportion. In order to help these patients to restore walking ability, a kind of walking aids device is required which can simulate the normal gait of humans. In this paper a kind of exoskeleton device is shown which has three freedoms of hip joint, knee joint and ankle joint. Firstly, the 3D model of this device will be built in pro/e, some kinematic and dynamics analysis based on D-H method and lagrangian method will be calculated. Secondly, a virtual prototype will be built in ADAMS to get the gait trajectory. Finally, use ADAMS and MATLAB to complete the feedback control of walking device.

articleTitle: The Research and Application of Improved Ant Colony Algorithm with Multi-thresholds in Edge Detection
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
