abstract: The traditional ant colony algorithm has been applied to image edge detection, but the result is not sufficiently ideal, and this paper puts forward an improved ant image edge detection algorithm. The improved algorithm optimizes the selection of the initial pheromone and ant's starting point, pheromone update strategy and ant's search termination condition; considering the edge curve's continuity, the inertia matrix is introduced to the heuristic information, and we set up multiple thresholds to make the edges more continuous, closer to the real edge and effective noise restraining. Compared with the traditional ant colony algorithm and Canny operator, the improved algorithm shows that it is more effective in detecting image edges.

articleTitle: A High-Precision Optical Flow Method Based on TV-L1 Model and Neighborhood Patch
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: There is usually occlusion area in moving object video images, which results in serious distortion of the extracted optical flow information. On the foundation of the comparative analysis of motion characteristics of traditional movement feature extraction methods, the crowd motion feature extraction algorithm based on TV-L1 model is proposed, using the optical flow information and occlusion neighborhood adjacent frame optical flow information, the occluded areas of missing information are repaired through two-way repair method. Experimental results show that the algorithm proposed in this paper can solve the problem of incomplete optical flow information in the occluded area. Compared with the traditional algorithm, this algorithm has better noise immunity and robustness.

articleTitle: Emission Coil Driving Subsystem for Crosswell Electromagnetic Logging Tools
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: A kind of driving system is designed for the large excitation current and inductance. The H bridge circuit is used in system to form a power inverter, and the unipolar doubling SPWM modulation is selected as the inverter control mode. Measuring the impedance characteristics of the emission coil, when the transmission frequency is less than 100Hz, the filtered sine wave is used to drive the transmission coil, and the series resonant emission mode is selected when the transmission frequency is more than 100Hz. The experimental results show that the emission current can reach about 1A at the low frequency and resonant frequency.

articleTitle: Research on the Design Strategy of Smartphone Shopping App for the Older Adults
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: This paper provides an overview of design strategy of shopping Apps for older adults, as well as a list theory of heuristic evaluation and cognitive walkthrough. Furthermore, this paper discusses three design objects for smartphone shopping apps, which is comprised with clear and concise information structure, user operation with high fault tolerance and the diversity of interactive forms. Moreover, it also presents the minimalist design theory should be used in the process of shopping App design for older adults, to work on the three strategies: information visualization, simple interaction design and "multi-platform" interaction.

articleTitle: Robot Workspace Reconstructing Solving Method Based on Image Engine
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: Research and application of spatial multi-joint robot become hot point in recent years. In this paper, a practical arc welding robot produced by ABB is selected as research subject, separate essential structural parameters of it, establish coordinate frame of link as well as D-H parameter list, analyze its forward kinematics and get position vector of the end-effector. Then, visual model is created to checkout rationality of the forward kinematics analysis. Finally, workspace reconstruction based on DirectX is raised. When researchers compare robot workspace simulation based on Monte Carlo method with our new method, the latter has the feature of modelling and digitization, which lays a foundation of designing arc welding robot efficiently and steadily.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Production System of Semiconductor Package Based on RFID and Sensor Technology
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: In view of the production process separation and main problems in the existing semiconductor package, this paper first proposed an intelligent production system with the main line of material flow on the basis of RFID and Sensor Technology. It also designs an intelligent production system project of the previous process of semiconductor package, integrating Manufacturing Execution System(MES) together with material flow automation system according to the characteristics of semiconductor package production. The core functions of this system are also analyzed. Finally, a intelligent management system of LED package production process is developed as its feasibility and effectiveness have been proved during testing and application.

articleTitle: A Review of Machine Learning Based Species' Distribution Modelling
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: This paper introduces four representative machine learning (ML) methods, i.e., random forest, MaxEnt, support vector machine and artificial neural network and reviews their application in species' distribution modelling (SDM), an inherently interdisciplinary field that requires close collaboration between ecologists and data scientists. The benefits and flaws of these ML methods are discussed in detail with several examples of contemporary SDM studies. To enhance practice efficiency in applying ML in SDM, a framework for division of work load between the two scientific communities is proposed. A better predictive power can be derived from hybrid ML approaches, such as ensemble learning. The deep learning method, however, has been largely underdeveloped in this field. Albeit challenging, the vast potential of applying deep learning in SDM needs to be seen, especially in an increasingly data-rich and open-access world.

articleTitle: A Combined Texture-Shape Global 3D Feature Descriptor for Object Recognition and Grasping
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: This paper presents a global 3D feature descriptor for object recognition and grasping. The proposed descriptor stems from the clustered viewpoint feature histogram (CVFH) feature descriptor. Since the CVFH feature descriptor relies on shape information only, it obtains a poor performance when recognizing the objects with similar shapes. In order to improve the robustness and accuracy of object recognition, we extend CVFH feature descriptor with color information. Then this new global 3D feature descriptor is tested for multiple classes of 3D object classification by using support vector machines (SVM), and it is evaluated with a public dataset and real scenes respectively. The experimental results show that the proposed descriptor outperforms the CVFH feature descriptor in terms of recognition rate. Finally we utilize the proposed descriptor on our grasping system to recognize and grasp the objects, showing that the grasping system can accomplish the tasks well.

articleTitle: Joint Weakly Parameter-Shared and Higher Order Statistical Criteria for Domain Adaptation
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: Domain adaptation is a particular case of transfer learning that applies labeled data in one or more related source domains, to learn a classifier for unseen or unlabeled data in a target domain. Recent studies reveal that a deep neural network can learn transferable features which generalize well to novel tasks with domain adaptation. However, most existing methods use the strongly parameter-shared architecture with the same weights for both source and target data, and transferring criteria commonly uses maximum mean discrepancy (MMD). In order to get more flexible and robust features, a new architecture joint weakly parameter-shared structure and higher order statistical criteria as transferring criteria is introduced. This architecture is a two-stream architecture, one of which operates in the source domain and the other in the target domain. Different from the strongly parameter-shared structure, the weakly parameter-shared structure allow the use of separate layers for different domain. In addition, central moment discrepancy (CMD), as a higher order statistical criteria, is used in the approach to measure domain feature discrepancy more accurate. The approach can extract more appropriate domain-invariant features and domain-specific features, making our model more robust and accurate. Experimental results on the digital datasets will show its competitive performance as compared with the other state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: Service-Oriented Sustainable Manufacturing towards Factory Floor Environment
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: Nowadays, the sustainable development of manufacturing has gained more and more attentions from governments and industries. A number of related researches and production activities have been carried out, in order to ensure the growth of economic while improve resource utilization rates, reduce environmental pollutions and promote the social harmonious development. Energy consumption has been regarded as the vital factor in the sustainable development of manufacturing, thus how to ensure the performance of manufacturing systems, the economic benefit of enterprises and the security of workers while get the optimal energy consumption of manufacturing process, has become the key to facilitate the sustainability of manufacturing industry. Service-oriented manufacturing is a novel manufacturing model which can realize servitization and centralized management of manufacturing resources and capabilities. It enables the consumers obtain the on-demand services of manufacturing resources and capabilities at any time and any place, integrates the existing manufacturing resources and capabilities during the whole life-cycle of production process. By the efforts of such manufacturing model, the utilizations rates of manufacturing resources and capabilities can be improved, and the energy consumption during production process can also be reduced, so as to provide an feasible and efficient way to approach the goal of sustainable development of manufacturing. Manufacturing equipments lay on the bottom layer of the architecture of a workshop manufacturing system, they are not only the main objects for executing manufacturing tasks such as machining, assembly, logistics, etc., but also are the basis of manufacturing service activities. In this context, taking the manufacturing equipments as the objectives and mainly focus on the energy-efficient factors, e.g. energy consumption and production efficiency, during the production process, this talk presents the related theories and methods for business model, operation mechanism and system integration of serviceoriented sustainable manufacturing towards factory floor environment, which including i) operation model and system architecture of service-oriented sustainable manufacturing towards factory floor environment, ii) multi-condition perception and data aggregation of manufacturing equipments, iii) energy-efficient and dynamic modeling of manufacturing equipment resources and capabilities, iv) energy-efficient and dynamic assessment of manufacturing equipment capabilities, v) energy-efficient management and dynamic optimization of manufacturing equipment services, and vi) integration of prototype systems and case studies. Plenty of experimental results and application demonstrations verify the effectiveness of the research works described in this talk, and therefore it can provide theoretical and technical basis for facilitating the sustainability of manufacturing activities in a factory floor environment, as well as the enhancement of intelligence level of production processes.
